name: Default Message Filter
helpText:
Implement a small FilterRule (accept(message): boolean), which Ikasan's DefaultMessageFilter wraps for you.

Prefer this over plain Message Filter if you already have a reusable FilterRule to plug in, or you'd rather return a boolean than remember whether to hand back the message or null yourself.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

configuration.helpText: Provide the bean type that contains bespoke configurations for this component.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configuredResource.helpText: Default: false. Allows the configuration to be exposed in the Ikasan console.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID is moduleName + flowName + componentName + componentType. Override it when multiple flows should share a configuration, or when renaming a flow without changing configuration already stored in the override-properties database.

fromType.helpText: The type of data we expect to come into the filter. This can be any Java class.
fromType.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name to be used as the type for the input to the filter.

requiresStub.helpText: Does this component require a stub to be generated by Studio, if not, it is assumed the user will provide the instance from its own factory class.

userImplementedClassName.helpText: The name of the class that will contain the custom filter rule (implementing org.ikasan.spec.component.filter.FilterRule), the IDE will create a template for this class, the user must provide the implementation.
userImplementedClassName.validationMessage: Provide a valid java classname for the filter rule e.g. starting with upper case, followed by number/characters etc.
